name: 壺屋焼窯元 育陶園
what: 壺屋やちむん通りの窯元の本店。唐草線彫の器や、育陶園の獅子を扱い、工房見学も案内する。
whatEn: The main shop of a kiln on Tsuboya Yachimun-dori, with carved arabesque tableware and its own shisa figures. It also arranges studio visits.
note: 唐草の線を見ながら、毎日使う器を一つ選びたい。
noteEn: I would choose one piece for daily use, looking at the carved arabesque lines.

name: 清正陶器・壺屋窯
what: 壺屋やちむん通りから一本入った路地の窯元の店。4代目の小橋川卓史が、父から継ぐ「赤絵魚紋」と自身の「希望の光」などの器を作る。
whatEn: A kiln shop down a lane off Tsuboya Yachimun-dori. Fourth-generation potter Takashi Kobashigawa makes the red fish designs inherited from his father and his own Light of Hope series.
note: 赤い魚の器を、家の食卓に置くつもりで選びたい。
noteEn: I would choose a red fish dish with my own table in mind.

name: 首里染織館 suikara
what: 首里当蔵町の、琉球びんがたと首里織の工房・ギャラリー・ショップ。二つの染織組合の職人が技を伝え、染めや織りの体験も行う。
whatEn: A studio, gallery and shop for Ryukyu bingata and Shuri-ori in Shuri Tonokura-cho. Artisans from the two textile cooperatives pass on their skills and offer dyeing and weaving workshops.
note: びんがたの色を見てから、持ち歩く小物を選びたい。
noteEn: I would look at the bingata colours before choosing something small to carry.

name: 瑞泉酒造
what: 首里崎山町で1887年に創業した泡盛の蔵元。売店では古酒や、戦前の黒麹菌で仕込む「御酒」を扱う。
whatEn: An awamori distillery founded in 1887 in Shuri Sakiyama-cho. Its shop sells aged kusu and Usaki, made with a strain of black koji preserved from before the war.
note: 古酒は、家で少しずつ飲む一本を選んで帰りたい。
noteEn: I would take home one bottle of aged awamori to drink a little at a time.

name: GARB DOMINGO
what: 壺屋のギャラリー兼セレクトショップ。沖縄と各地の作り手の陶器、漆器、ガラス、木工を紹介し、個展も開く。
whatEn: A gallery and select shop in Tsuboya, showing ceramics, lacquerware, glass and woodwork by makers from Okinawa and elsewhere, with solo exhibitions.
note: 陶器だけでなく、ガラスや木のものも一つずつ見たい。
noteEn: I would look at the glass and wooden pieces one by one, as well as the pottery.

name: miyagiya
what: 松尾の器と服のセレクトショップ。店主が工房で選ぶやちむんに、琉球ガラスや布、ジュエリーなどを合わせて紹介する。
whatEn: A shop for tableware and clothing in Matsuo. Yachimun chosen by the owner on studio visits sits alongside Ryukyu glass, textiles and jewellery.
note: 器も服も、家でふだん使うものとして選んでみたい。
noteEn: I would choose both the dishes and the clothes for everyday life at home.

name: COFFEE potohoto
what: 安里の栄町市場にあるコーヒー豆の店。産地ごとの豆とオリジナルブレンドを焙煎して売る。
whatEn: A coffee bean shop in Sakaemachi Market, Asato, roasting and selling single-origin coffees and its own blends.
note: 産地の違う豆を見比べて、飲んだことのない一袋を。
noteEn: I would compare the origins and take a bag I have never tried.

name: TAMAGUSUKU COFFEE ROASTERS
address: 那覇市松尾2-19-39 グリーンハイツ那覇202
what: 松尾のグリーンハイツ那覇202号室にある、自家焙煎のスペシャルティコーヒー店。豆の販売のほか、ラテやカプチーノも。
whatEn: A specialty coffee roaster in Room 202 of Green Heights Naha in Matsuo. It sells beans and serves drinks including lattes and cappuccinos.
note: 浅煎りの豆を選んで、家でもゆっくり飲んでみたい。
noteEn: I would choose a light roast to brew slowly at home.

name: デザートラボショコラ
what: 首里金城町の洋菓子店。チョコレートの菓子や、フィナンシェ「Shulien」、伊江ラムレーズンサンドを作る。
whatEn: A patisserie in Shuri Kinjo-cho making chocolate sweets, Shulien financiers and Ie-rum raisin sandwiches.
note: 焼き菓子を選ぶなら、伊江ラムのレーズンサンドを。
noteEn: For a baked sweet, I would choose the Ie-rum raisin sandwich.

name: 安里屋すば
what: 安里の立ち食い沖縄そば店。木灰を使った自家製麺に、北海道の真昆布・鰹・豚骨の出汁を合わせ、ジューシーも出す。
whatEn: A stand-up Okinawa soba shop in Asato, serving house-made wood-ash noodles in a broth of Hokkaido kelp, bonito and pork bones, with jushi seasoned rice too.
note: 木灰の麺を味わいたいので、まずはかけすばを頼む。
noteEn: I would start with plain kake suba to taste the wood-ash noodles.
